title: We thought building our own TradingView-like charts would be the easy part. lol
author: Accomplished-Car8427
selftext:
So… we had a slightly stupid idea.

We’re building a platform where people can train their own RL trading models. Since those models need market data, we already had a lot of the data infrastructure in place.

At some point one of us said: Why are we still paying so much for TradingView? We already have the data. Let’s just build our own market overview.

Sounded pretty reasonable at the time.

We massively underestimated it.

Displaying a few candles isn’t really the problem. It’s everything that comes after that. Real-time updates, changing timeframes without things freezing, syncing charts, calculating indicators, resizing layouts and trying not to kill the browser when someone opens a ridiculous number of charts.

Every time we thought it was nearly done, we found another ten things that were not nearly done.

The original motivation was honestly just the price. TradingView currently puts 16 charts per tab in its Ultimate plan, which is around $200/month when billed annually. The Premium plan with 25 indicators per chart is around $60/month.

That felt insane to us.

After building this, I still think it’s expensive… but I understand the price a little better now.

Our version currently has no fixed limit on the number of charts. Your screen and computer are basically the limit. In theory you could open 200+ charts at once, although I have absolutely no idea why a normal person would need that many.

We also have 36 indicators at the moment, which can be displayed simultaneously, and we’re adding more regularly.

It’s free to use during the beta and anyone can try it. Just to be transparent, the larger platform won’t stay free forever. Right now, though, feedback is genuinely more valuable to us than charging people for it.

We’ve been staring at this thing for so long that we’ve lost all perspective on what is actually useful, what is confusing and what nobody needs.

Here’s the link: [**https://trade.blackiq.ai/**](https://trade.blackiq.ai/)

If anyone tries it, please don’t just tell us it looks good. Tell us what sucks, what’s missing or what feels unnecessarily complicated.

**Also, how many charts do you actually have open during a normal trading session? And what would a new charting tool need to have for you to seriously consider using it instead of TradingView?**
